newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Dell Q2 on track-Montgomery.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Dell Q2 on track-Montgomery.

text.p: In making positive comments about Dell Computer Corp, Montgomery Securities analyst Kurt King observed that the direct marketer of personal computers is on track with its second quarter earnings, Montgomery said.

-- King did not change his rating or earnings estimates on Dell. Dell's shares have been under pressure in recent days over investors' nervousness about its second quarter, which ends July 31. Dell shares were up 3-3/8 to 117-3/4.
-- King maintains a buy rating on Dell and his second quarter earnings estimates are for $1.04 a share, a Montgomery spokeswoman said. King was not available for comment.
